title: pilosella auriculoides subsp. echiogenes
intro: Pilosella auriculoides subsp. echiogenes, commonly known as Alpine Hawkweed, is a perennial plant that belongs to the Rosaceae family and is native to the European alpine regions. It is valued for its medicinal properties, which include its ability to promote digestion, reduce inflammation, and exhibit antioxidant effects. The therapeutic actions of Pilosella auriculoides subsp. echiogenes are attributed to its bioactive constituents, such as sesquiterpene lactones and flavonoids, which have been shown to possess anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and hepatoprotective properties. Additionally, this plant has been traditionally used to treat various health issues, including gastrointestinal disorders, skin conditions, and respiratory problems.
